description: This file defines the IRPCLink interface and its nested INotification interface for communication over process boundaries within the WPEFramework project. It includes method declarations for registering notifications and starting/stopping callback operations.

classes.name: IRPCLink
classes.description: An interface for remote procedure call link, allowing registration of notifications and control over communication state.

classes.name: IRPCLink::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about completion events related to the RPC link.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler to receive events from the RPC link.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification handler, stopping event notifications.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the RPC link with a specified ID and name, returning a status code.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the RPC link, returning a status code.

methods.name: ForceCallback
methods.description: Forces an immediate callback, possibly for testing or prompt response.

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IRPCLink
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IRPCLink : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
